Funds.Name: Zakat
Funds.PolicyNotes: Use only for Sharia-eligible beneficiaries; segregated tracking required.

Funds.Name: General / Unrestricted
Funds.PolicyNotes: Can support approved operations within policy.

Funds.Name: Restricted Grant / Partner Funds
Funds.PolicyNotes: Use only as agreed with donor.

Funds.Name: Operations / Admin
Funds.PolicyNotes: Use for approved operating and support costs.

Funds.Name: Capital Expenditure
Funds.PolicyNotes: Track separately for major fixed assets and capital acquisitions.

Buckets.Name: Zakat Program Distribution
Buckets.PolicyRule: Disburse Zakat only to Sharia-eligible asnaf categories.
Buckets.TypicalUse: Cash assistance, food, debt relief, eligible relief

Buckets.Name: Zakat Amil Share
Buckets.PolicyRule: Zakat collectors' share; capped at 12.5% and must be directly tied to collecting/administering zakat.
Buckets.TypicalUse: Zakat collection/admin staff and direct zakat administration

Buckets.Name: Restricted Project Program
Buckets.PolicyRule: Disburse only per the donor's purpose/contract.

Buckets.Name: Restricted Admin Recovery
Buckets.PolicyRule: Admin rate allowed only if the contract/donor permits; default cap 15%.

Buckets.Name: General Donation Program
Buckets.PolicyRule: General donations for programs per approved priority.

Buckets.Name: General Donation Admin
Buckets.PolicyRule: Admin support from general donations per policy and approval.

Buckets.Name: Sadaqah Program
Buckets.PolicyRule: Sadaqah for humanitarian programs unless the donor restricts it.

Buckets.Name: Sadaqah Admin
Buckets.PolicyRule: Used for operations only if not prohibited by the donor, or if designated for that purpose.
Buckets.TypicalUse: Admin support linked to sadaqah operations

Buckets.Name: Operations Pool
Buckets.PolicyRule: Operating pool receiving allowed admin rates or direct admin support.

Buckets.Name: Capital Assets
Buckets.PolicyRule: For assets and capital expenditures per the capital spending policy.

OpeningBalances.Notes: Restricted opening balance carried from 2025. Must be included in cash flow and fund balance.
